items.title: Show HN: OpenCode server and TUI in a browser tab (Chrome desktop)
items.contentSnippet:
- mostly unmodified OpenCode server and TUI, not a reimplementation
- sign in with your ChatGPT plan w/ device code
- opencode free tier works (for now)
- requires a relay because of CORS (a public Wisp server by default); TLS runs in the tab, so it sees only encrypted bytes
- stack is simple Vite+React app with HMR, but can run other stacks including full stack fully in browser
- embeddable in your own web app, not hosted
- Only Chrome desktop for now; first load is about 45 MB
- uses less memo

items.title: Show HN: Korosta – Remember and highlight job postings you've seen
items.contentSnippet:
# What is and whats not
Korosta is a privacy-first user-customizable tool to highlight job postings based on how frequent are those, and your ratings:
* how often the job postings appeared to the user -> fade repeatedly seen job postings
* learns from your ratings with a simple local model -> highlight relevant ones
* 2 versions: free and pro
* almost everything is kept local (ratings, recipes, customizations, history), only licensing and payments require a server
* no account required to use it
